title: Figma Design - Claims Commercial - Baseline - Mass Event Linkage Navigation & Manual Edit
walkthroughSteps: Navigate to /claims/CLM-2024-001/overview — the claim is already linked to a mass event by default

walkthroughSteps.title: Mass Event linkage
walkthroughSteps.body: The info icon next to Mass Event opens a popover with the event's details and manual linkage actions.
walkthroughSteps.expectedAfterClick: A popover appears showing the mass event's type, code, period and location, plus Link/Unlink/Confirm actions depending on the claim's current link status.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Mass event linkage details and manual edit actions are reachable from the overview
acceptanceCriteria.plainStatement: Clicking the info icon next to **Mass Event** opens a popover with the linked event's details and manual link/unlink actions.

setup.description: CLM-2024-001 already has a mass event linked by default — no override needed

preconditions.text: Mass Event field is visible with a linked event id

expectedUI.description: Mass event popover shows event details and manual actions
visualCues: Popover header shows event id and name
Link mass event / Unlink mass event / Confirm link actions present

howToTest.trigger: Click the info icon next to Mass Event
howToTest.expectedResult: Popover opens with the event's details and manual link actions
